BiblicalUsage: Joiakim is named 3 times in the Bible, and the passages here are Nehemiah 12:10; Nehemiah 12:12; Nehemiah 12:26. In Nehemiah 12:10 we read, "And Jeshua begat Joiakim, Joiakim also begat Eliashib, and Eliashib begat Joiada,". It appears again in Nehemiah 12:26: "These were in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the governor..."
TheologicalSignificance: Joiakim belongs in the record, and my position is that the small names matter as much as the great ones. That is why I do not skip the lists: every name in them was loved.
